exposure: Discontinuation of disease-modifying therapies (DMTs) before pregnancy
Type of disease-modifying therapy (natalizumab, fingolimod, interferon beta, glatiramer acetate)
outcome: Multiple sclerosis relapses (before, during, and postpartum)
cohort: 66 women (75 pregnancy plans) with multiple sclerosis who desire to bear children, with a mean age of 32.1 years.
finding: Discontinuation of disease-modifying therapies (DMTs) before pregnancy was associated with relapses, and natalizumab or fingolimod prior to pregnancy resulted in a higher relapse rate during pregnancy compared to interferon beta or glatiramer acetate.
